packs.title: Art, Lakes & Paths
packs.promise: Explore Minneapolis through art rooms, public gardens, lake edges and a river-city campus.

q.s: Find two forms that pull your eye in different directions
st: In an open Walker gallery, choose two works with noticeably different forms.
Sketch a simple line from each work without copying the full artwork.
Write which line makes your eye move faster and why.

q.s: Compare one form from two safe viewpoints
st: Choose one outdoor sculpture and observe it from the public path.
Move to a second safe viewpoint without crossing a planting bed.
Describe one shape that appears to change as you move.

q.s: Separate waterfall, path and nearby human sounds
st: Reach an open upper overlook by a public path; do not descend wet or icy stairs.
Listen briefly for the falls, a closer path sound and one changing sound.
Write the sounds in near-to-far order and note how the water changes with season.

packs.title: Two Banks of the Falls
packs.promise: Follow the connected Mill District and St. Anthony Falls riverfront over one or two afternoons.

q.s: Find planted, built and river layers at Water Works
st: From the open Water Works terrace, identify a planted area, preserved mill material and the river beyond.
Sketch them as three horizontal layers.
Write which layer tells you most about the place today.

q.s: Compare one building edge with a river line
st: From the public sidewalk outside the Guthrie, find a strong edge of its blue exterior.
Pair that edge with a visible riverfront line in a quick sketch.
Write how architecture directs your view toward the river.

q.s: Count a repeating bridge shape from a safe path
st: Use the open public bridge approach or pedestrian path.
Count a short sequence of repeated stone arches from a safe viewpoint.
Sketch how the arches shrink into distance.
